verdict.rationale: Channel3's only documented background behavior is price-tracking subscriptions: once a user subscribes to a product, Channel3 monitors it on an ongoing basis and fires webhooks on price changes. This is a narrow, single-purpose monitor rather than general user-defined automations; the CLI and SDK are on-demand calls, not scheduled jobs. Missing for 10: general-purpose configurable automations or scheduled tasks, triggers or actions beyond price-change alerts, documentation of autonomous background agent runs, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: When you subscribe to price tracking for a product, you can receive webhook notifications whenever the price changes.
